text.ms: Bungkusan anda tertahan di stor. Bayar caj RM2.50 di kurier-bayar.test/x dalam 24 jam atau dipulangkan.
text.en: Your parcel is held at the depot. Pay a RM2.50 fee at kurier-bayar.test/x within 24 hours or it gets sent back.

why.ms: Minta bayar dulu melalui pautan dan letak had masa. Semak terus dalam apl kurier yang anda pasang sendiri.
why.en: Pay first through a link, with a deadline. Check in the courier app you installed yourself.

text.ms: Hai! Kerja part-time tengok video, RM300 sehari, boleh buat dari bilik je. Cuma kena bayar yuran daftar RM50 dulu ya.
text.en: Hi! Part-time job watching videos, RM300 a day, from your room. Just pay a RM50 sign-up fee first.

why.ms: Gaji terlalu tinggi untuk kerja mudah, dan majikan sebenar tak minta yuran dulu.
why.en: Pay too high for easy work, and a real employer does not ask for a fee first.

text.ms: AMARAN: Akaun anda akan DISEKAT dalam 1 jam kerana aktiviti mencurigakan. Sahkan sekarang di bankku-sah.test/a
text.en: WARNING: Your account will be BLOCKED within 1 hour due to suspicious activity. Verify now at bankku-sah.test/a

why.ms: Menakutkan dan terburu-buru, dengan pautan yang bukan alamat rasmi bank.
why.en: Scary and rushed, with a link that is not the bank's real address.

text.ms: Untung 30% seminggu, modal RM500 pun boleh! 200 orang dah join kumpulan kami. Slot hari ni tinggal 3 je.
text.en: 30% profit a week, even with RM500! 200 people already joined our group. Only 3 slots left today.

why.ms: Untung 30% seminggu jauh terlalu tinggi. Ramai yang join tak bermakna ia selamat.
why.en: 30% a week is far too high. Many people joining does not make it safe.

text.ms: Nama awak dikaitkan dengan kes pengubahan wang haram. Jangan beritahu sesiapa, termasuk keluarga, dan ikut arahan saya.
text.en: Your name is linked to a money laundering case. Do not tell anyone, including family, and follow my instructions.

why.ms: Polis sebenar tak suruh anda berahsia. Hubungi 997 sendiri untuk semak.
why.en: Real police do not tell you to keep quiet. Call 997 yourself to check.

text.ms: TAHNIAH! Anda menang RM5,000 dalam cabutan bertuah. Balas e-mel ini dengan nama penuh dan nombor akaun untuk terima hadiah.
text.en: CONGRATULATIONS! You won RM5,000 in a lucky draw. Reply with your full name and account number to claim the prize.

why.ms: Anda tak masuk cabutan pun, tapi hadiah minta butiran akaun. Itu umpan.
why.en: You never entered a draw, yet the prize wants your account details. That is bait.

text.ms: Sayang, abang kecemasan kat luar negara. Kita kenal online je, tapi abang percaya awak. Tolong transfer RM800 sekarang ya. Jangan cerita kat family dulu, nanti abang ganti.
text.en: Darling, I have an emergency abroad. We only know each other online, but I trust you. Please transfer RM800 right now. Do not tell your family yet, I will pay you back.

why.ms: Orang yang kenal lama online dan minta duit sambil suruh rahsia ialah tanda penipuan cinta.
why.en: An online-only partner asking for money and secrecy is a love scam sign.

text.ms: Pinjaman RM5,000 anda diluluskan tanpa semakan! Bayar duit proses RM200 dulu ke akaun kami untuk keluarkan wang.
text.en: Your RM5,000 loan is approved with no checks! Pay a RM200 processing fee to our account first to release the money.

why.ms: Pemberi pinjaman sah tak minta bayar dulu sebelum duit masuk.
why.en: A genuine lender never asks you to pay before the money arrives.

text.ms: Kasut tu tinggal 1 pasang je, ramai nak. Bayar deposit RM100 sekarang untuk simpan, kita tak boleh jumpa, saya hantar je.
text.en: Only 1 pair left and lots of people want it. Pay a RM100 deposit now to hold it. We cannot meet, I will just post it.

why.ms: Bayar dulu kepada orang yang tak boleh dijumpa itu berisiko. Pilih COD atau jumpa dulu.
why.en: Paying first to someone you cannot meet is risky. Choose cash on delivery or meet first.

text.ms: Kami nampak transaksi pelik RM2,300. Untuk batalkan, baca balik kod TAC yang baru anda terima kepada pegawai kami.
text.en: We spotted a strange RM2,300 transaction. To cancel it, read the TAC you just received to our officer.

why.ms: Bank tak pernah minta TAC anda. Kod itu untuk anda sahaja.
why.en: A bank never asks for your TAC. That code is for you alone.

text.ms: Anda terpilih untuk biasiswa RM3,000. Bayar yuran pemprosesan RM30 hari ini untuk kekalkan tempat anda.
text.en: You have been picked for a RM3,000 scholarship. Pay a RM30 processing fee today to keep your place.

why.ms: Biasiswa sebenar tak minta anda bayar untuk menerimanya.
why.en: A real scholarship never asks you to pay to receive it.

text.ms: Weh ni aku, Danial. Phone aku rosak, guna nombor baru. Boleh tolong bayarkan bil RM300 sekarang? Aku ganti petang ni.
text.en: Hey it's me, Danial. My phone broke, using a new number. Can you pay a RM300 bill for me right now? I'll pay you back this evening.

why.ms: Nombor baru yang mengaku kawan dan minta duit cepat. Telefon nombor lama dia dulu.
why.en: A new number claiming to be a friend and asking for quick money. Call his old number first.

text.ms: Pinjamkan akaun bank awak untuk terima bayaran pelanggan. Setiap transaksi awak dapat RM200. Senyap-senyap je, jangan bagitahu bank.
text.en: Lend us your bank account to receive customer payments. You get RM200 per transaction. Keep it quiet, don't tell the bank.

why.ms: Ini mengupah anda jadi keldai akaun, dan anda yang boleh didakwa. Jangan.
why.en: This hires you as a money mule, and you can be charged. Do not.

text.ms: Transaksi RM89.90 di KedaiOnline. Bukan anda? Hubungi nombor di belakang kad.
text.en: Transaction of RM89.90 at KedaiOnline. Not you? Call the number on the back of your card.

why.ms: Tiada pautan, tiada OTP diminta, minta anda guna nombor rasmi sendiri.
why.en: No link, no OTP asked, and it tells you to use the official number you already have.

text.ms: Akaun Sembang anda akan DIPADAM hari ni kerana aduan. Klik sembang-sah.test/p untuk elak dipadam.
text.en: Your Chat account will be DELETED today due to a complaint. Click sembang-sah.test/p to stop it.

why.ms: Ugutan padam akaun dengan pautan pelik. Buka apl sendiri untuk semak.
why.en: A deletion threat with an odd link. Open the app yourself to check.

text.ms: Pelaburan jaminan untung 15% sebulan, TIADA risiko. Pelanggan kami dah kaya! Lihat gambar kereta baru mereka dan sertai hari ini.
text.en: Investment with a guaranteed 15% profit a month, NO risk. Our clients got rich! See photos of their new cars and join today.

why.ms: Tiada pelaburan sebenar yang jamin untung tinggi tanpa risiko. Gambar kereta tak bukti apa-apa.
why.en: No real investment guarantees high profit with no risk. Photos of cars prove nothing.

text.ms: Tunggakan RM1,200 anda belum dibayar. Bayar HARI INI atau kami hubungi majikan dan keluarga anda.
text.en: Your RM1,200 arrears are unpaid. Pay TODAY or we will contact your employer and family.

why.ms: Ugutan malukan anda depan orang lain. Semak baki dalam apl rasmi sendiri.
why.en: A threat to embarrass you in front of others. Check your balance in the official app yourself.

text.ms: Waran tangkap telah dikeluarkan atas nama anda. Bayar denda RM1,500 sekarang melalui akaun ini untuk batalkan waran.
text.en: An arrest warrant has been issued in your name. Pay a RM1,500 fine now into this account to cancel the warrant.

why.ms: Mahkamah tak minta denda melalui mesej ke akaun peribadi. Tenang, dan hubungi 997.
why.en: Courts do not ask for fines by message into a personal account. Stay calm and call 997.

text.ms: Semua dah dapat RM50 free! Awak je belum. Kongsi pautan hadiah-raya.test/g kepada 5 kawan, lepas tu isi kata laluan e-dompet untuk terima.
text.en: Everyone already got RM50 free! Only you haven't. Share hadiah-raya.test/g with 5 friends, then enter your e-wallet password to receive it.

why.ms: Tekanan 'semua dah dapat' dan minta kata laluan. Kata laluan tak patut dikongsi.
why.en: 'Everyone got it' pressure plus a password request. Passwords are never to be shared.

text.ms: Baki akaun anda RM1,240.50 pada 7 Nov. Untuk lihat penyata penuh, buka apl BankKu yang anda dah pasang.
text.en: Your account balance is RM1,240.50 on 7 Nov. To see the full statement, open the BankKu app you already installed.

why.ms: Hanya memberitahu baki, tiada pautan, tiada permintaan maklumat. Anda buka apl sendiri.
why.en: It only tells you the balance, with no link and no request for details. You open your own app.

text.ms: Hai Aina, shift Sabtu ni 10 pagi sampai 4 petang ya. Gaji masuk hujung bulan. Ada soalan, tanya Kak Min kat kaunter je.
text.en: Hi Aina, your shift this Saturday is 10 am to 4 pm. Pay comes at month end. Any questions, just ask Kak Min at the counter.

why.ms: Tiada yuran, ada orang sebenar di kedai yang boleh anda jumpa dan tanya.
why.en: No fee, and a real person at the shop you can meet and ask.

text.ms: Kelas Ekonomi 101 ditukar ke Dewan B, Khamis 2 petang. Jadual penuh ada di papan kenyataan fakulti dan portal pelajar yang anda guna biasa.
text.en: Economics 101 moves to Hall B, Thursday 2 pm. The full timetable is on the faculty notice board and the student portal you normally use.

why.ms: Maklumat biasa, tiada pautan, tiada bayaran. Boleh disahkan di papan kenyataan.
why.en: Ordinary news with no link and no payment. You can confirm it on the notice board.

text.ms: Bungkusan anda dalam perjalanan, dijangka sampai esok. Tiada bayaran diperlukan. Jejak dalam apl KurierKilat anda atau tanya penjual.
text.en: Your parcel is on the way and should arrive tomorrow. No payment needed. Track it in your KurierKilat app or ask the seller.

why.ms: Tiada caj, tiada pautan, dan suruh anda semak dalam apl sendiri.
why.en: No fee, no link, and it points you to your own app.

text.ms: Akak, mak dah masuk duit RM200 untuk beli buku. Nanti tengok akaun ya. Makan jangan lupa.
text.en: Sis, I put RM200 in for your books. Check your account later. Don't forget to eat.

why.ms: Mak memberi duit, bukan meminta. Anda boleh semak sendiri dalam apl bank.
why.en: Mum is giving money, not asking. You can check it yourself in your bank app.

text.ms: Kad debit anda tamat tempoh bulan depan. Kad baharu dihantar ke alamat berdaftar. Ada soalan? Hubungi nombor di belakang kad.
text.en: Your debit card expires next month. A new card will be sent to your registered address. Questions? Call the number on the back of your card.

why.ms: Tiada pautan, tiada kod diminta, dan beri jalan semak melalui nombor di kad.
why.en: No link, no code asked, and a way to verify through the number on your card.

text.ms: Bro, semalam aku bayarkan makan kita RM12. Bila free bagi balik, tunai pun boleh. Jumpa kat kelas esok ek.
text.en: Bro, yesterday I covered our lunch, RM12. Give it back when you're free, cash is fine. See you in class tomorrow.

why.ms: Jumlah kecil, kawan yang anda kenal, tiada desakan. Boleh bayar tunai bila jumpa.
why.en: A small amount from a friend you know, with no pressure. You can pay cash when you meet.

text.ms: Penyata bulanan anda sudah sedia. Nilai unit boleh naik dan turun. Log masuk dengan cara biasa atau tanya di mana-mana kaunter cawangan.
text.en: Your monthly statement is ready. Unit values can go up and down. Log in the usual way or ask at any branch counter.

why.ms: Tiada janji untung, tiada pautan, dan ingatkan nilai boleh turun. Jujur tentang risiko.
why.en: No promised profit, no link, and it says values can fall. Honest about risk.

text.ms: Peringatan: temujanji gigi anda esok 9:30 pagi. Nak tukar masa? Telefon klinik guna nombor pada slip temujanji anda.
text.en: Reminder: your dental appointment is tomorrow at 9:30 am. Want to change the time? Call the clinic using the number on your appointment slip.

why.ms: Tiada bayaran atau pautan; telefon klinik guna nombor yang kamu sendiri simpan.
why.en: No payment or link; call the clinic on a number you saved yourself.

text.ms: Kasut tu masih ada saiz 8. Boleh jumpa kat depan perpustakaan, tengok dulu, kalau ok baru bayar tunai. Tak jadi pun takpe.
text.en: Those shoes are still in size 8. Meet in front of the library, look first, pay cash only if you like them. No hard feelings if not.

why.ms: Jumpa dulu, tengok barang, baru bayar. Tiada deposit dan tiada desakan.
why.en: Meet, see the item, then pay. No deposit and no pressure.

text.ms: Resit #1042: langganan bulanan RM9.90, tarikh 7 Nov. Tak kenal pembelian ini? Semak penyata bank dalam apl anda sendiri.
text.en: Receipt #1042: monthly subscription RM9.90, 7 Nov. Don't recognise this purchase? Check your bank statement in your own app.

why.ms: Tiada pautan, tiada nombor untuk dihubungi; semak dalam apl sendiri.
why.en: No link and no number to call; check in your own app.
